corinthians1.6.p1.b1.text: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!

corinthians1.6.p1.b2.text: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? … are you not competent to judge trivial cases?

corinthians1.6.p1.b3.text: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!

corinthians1.6.p2.b4.text: So if you need to settle everyday matters, do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church?

corinthians1.6.p2.b5.text: I say this to your shame. Is there really no one among you wise enough to arbitrate between his brothers?

corinthians1.6.p2.b6.text: Instead, one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!

corinthians1.6.p3.b7.text: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already.

corinthians1.6.p3.b8.text: Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?

corinthians1.6.p3.b9.text: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, even against your own brothers!

corinthians1.6.p4.b10.text: Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived:

corinthians1.6.p4.b11.text: And that is what some of you were.

corinthians1.6.p4.b12.text: But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified …

corinthians1.6.p5.b13.text: “Everything is permissible for me,” but not everything is beneficial.

corinthians1.6.p5.b14.text: “Food for the stomach and the stomach for food,” but God will destroy them both.

corinthians1.6.p5.b15.text: By His power God raised the Lord from the dead, and He will raise us also.

corinthians1.6.p6.b16.text: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? … Never!

corinthians1.6.p6.b17.text: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with Him in spirit.

corinthians1.6.p7.b19.text: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have received from God?

corinthians1.6.p7.b20.text: You are not your own; you were bought at a price.

corinthians1.6.p7.b21.text: Therefore glorify God with your body.
